title: Latest application cloud, context and project containment acceptance
user_story: The owner uses current application source rather than trusting the old6.3.0 preview on main/dev/qa.

requirements.description: Consolidate latest application behavior and retain honest permanent acceptance tests

nonfunctional: No live or paid model calls
preconditions: Preserved worktrees and actual CI artifacts
acceptance_criteria: Full selected PDF includes final-page results
Settings persists actual model rules and bounded budgets
No live-provider or OS isolation certification is inferred from fixtures

scenarios.expected: All selected PDF pages remain available
Cloud is never a local unload target
Framing stays within declared budget with original hash
Missing authentication and disabled preconnection make no network request
Unrestricted host launch and missing isolation fail closed
History is explicitly budgeted without arbitrary20-message slicing

recovery: Preserve raw failure. At most3 repair attempts per stable defect group. No waiver has been approved.
test_environment: Disposable local subprocess and file fixtures. Not live merge or AI acceptance.

review.method: Same-agent adversarial review, not independent approval

tdd.scope: Retrospective acceptance comparison of unchanged context tests against pre-integration and integrated source, not a claim original implementation followed test-first development. Cloud/security have current GREEN execution, no retrospective RED claimed.
